issue: Current source-only suite output serializes whole replacement files. A valid real upstream patch exceeds the fixed artifact bound before any execution.
recommended_direction: Add separately versioned compact diff artifact support using an existing reviewed parser/apply tool; preserve legacy whole-file contracts, strict existing-file edit scope, context validation, archive/output bounds and protected tests. Verify source before new runtime or model work. No new evaluation framework or service.
status: Inert design finding only; not implemented or approved for third-party installation/execution.
caveat: Byte sizes describe artifacts only; no token, time, memory, monetary savings or model usefulness inferred.
